etymology.historical_story: Glenda is a personal name with uncertain origins. Although it is often explained through Welsh words meaning pure and good, onomastic research notes that early British examples were outside Wales. The Welsh explanation may therefore be a later reinterpretation rather than a securely established account of its original creation. See the [American Name Society](https://www.americannamesociety.org/about-names-where-did-the-name-glenda-come-from-and-where-did-it-go/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Glenda 读作近似“格伦达”，记住它指一个人的名字；不要把名字的词源解释当成马来语词义。
